item.title: Meet The Real Persian Royals Behind The Viral ‘Princess Qajar’ Memes
item.description: The legendary "Princess Qajar” is actually a conflation of two 19th-century Persian royals — Fatemeh Khanum "Esmat al-Dowleh" and Zahra Khanum "Taj al-Saltaneh.” The post Meet The Real Persian Royals Behind The Viral ‘Princess Qajar’ Memes appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: Scientists Have Captured Jaguars ‘Meowing’ For The First Time Ever

item.title: Here’s What Life Looks Like In Oymyakon, The Coldest City In The World
item.description: Located near the Arctic Circle, Oymyakon, Russia is the coldest inhabited place on Earth. Winter temperatures average around -58°F — and only 500 residents brave the chill.
